entities.summary: Vicedomino de Vicedominis was an Italian cardinal who played a significant role in the Catholic Church during the Medieval era. He was born into a wealthy family and rose through the ranks to become a prominent figure in the Church. Vicedomino de Vicedominis was instrumental in the construction of several important churches and cathedrals in Italy, including the Basilica of San Lorenzo in Milan. His legacy can still be seen in the architecture and art of these buildings. The cardinal's association with the Church helped to establish a sense of continuity and tradition, which was essential for the Church's survival during a time of great upheaval. Vicedomino de Vicedominis died in 1276, leaving behind a lasting impact on the Catholic Church and the city of Milan. Despite his death, his influence can still be felt today, and he remains an important figure in the history of the Church.
